response: The Deformity Angular Ratio (DAR) is indeed correlated with high-risk cases for potential spinal cord monitoring alerts in pediatric 3-column thoracic spinal deformity corrective surgery. According to the research, the DAR was predictive of patients developing intraoperative motor evoked potential alerts. This suggests that identifying accurate radiographical, patient, and procedural risk factors, such as the DAR, can help prepare the surgical team to improve safety and outcomes when carrying out complex spinal corrections in pediatric patients with severe spinal deformities. By using the DAR as a predictive tool, surgeons can take proactive measures to minimize the risk of spinal cord injury and optimize patient outcomes.
